name: 66048 · Leavenworth, KS
findings: ZIP 66048 (Leavenworth) has 140 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66048 (Leavenworth) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66048 (Leavenworth) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
